sloka: इमं श्रुत्वा तु वृत्तान्तं त्वरमाणो ऽहमागतः ।सहसा युवयोः स्नेहात् सखित्वमनुपालयन् ।। ६.५०.५१ ।।।।
transliteration: imaṁ śrutvā tu vṛttāntaṁ tvaramāṇo 'hamāgataḥ ।sahasā yuvayoḥ snehāt sakhitvamanupālayan ।। 6.50.51 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard the information about both of you bound by serpents, out of my friendship and affection and in obedience to you I hastened and reached here."
